test.create_query: CREATE TABLE missing_small_{array_type} (set Array({array_type}), subset Array({array_type})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE missing_medium_{array_type} (set Array({array_type}), subset Array({array_type})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE nullable_found_small_{array_type} (set Array(Nullable({array_type})), subset Array(Nullable({array_type}))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE nullable_found_medium_{array_type} (set Array(Nullable({array_type})), subset Array(Nullable({array_type}))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE nullable_missing_medium_{array_type} (set Array(Nullable({array_type})), subset Array(Nullable({array_type}))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO missing_small_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(v -> v % 100, groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(1))), arrayMap(v -> 100 + v % 100, groupArraySample(500)(rand64(2))) FROM numbers(10000000) GROUP BY number % 5000

INSERT INTO missing_medium_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(v -> v % 100, groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(1))), arrayMap(v -> 100 + v % 100, groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(2))) FROM numbers(6250000) GROUP BY number % 12500

INSERT INTO nullable_found_small_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(v -> if(v % 64 = 0, NULL, v), groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(1))), arrayMap(v -> if(v % 64 = 0, NULL, v), groupArraySample(500)(rand64(1))) FROM numbers(10000000) GROUP BY number % 5000

INSERT INTO nullable_found_medium_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(v -> if(v % 64 = 0, NULL, v), groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(1))), arrayMap(v -> if(v % 64 = 0, NULL, v), groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(1))) FROM numbers(12500000) GROUP BY number % 25000

INSERT INTO nullable_missing_medium_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(v -> if(v % 64 = 0, NULL, v % 100), groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(1))), arrayMap(v -> toNullable(100 + v % 100), groupArraySample(5000)(rand64(2))) FROM numbers(6250000) GROUP BY number % 12500
test.query: SELECT hasAny(set, subset) FROM missing_small_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAny(set, subset) FROM missing_medium_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM nullable_found_small_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM nullable_found_medium_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAny(set, subset) FROM nullable_missing_medium_{array_type} FORMAT Null
